title: D-024 Amendment 41: controller-update source binding to the immutable accepted candidate 1489879e (runbook section-4 repair, fail-closed install/verify script, negative and mutation ps_tests)
objective: Repair the canonical controller-update procedure so the sole checked-in path sources the installation from the immutable accepted production candidate SHA 1489879e1f6787a9d53ed74db4524b24039e03a2 with fail-closed pre-copy identity verification (repo/origin/commit/tree/modules/detached-worktree), post-copy content-digest proof, manifest and update-evidence provenance binding, checked-in parse-tested PowerShell 5.1 owner commands under the command-document tooth, and negative/mutation coverage for the six rejection classes (D-024-R607..R621), before any controller update or canary.
business_reason: Owner decision 2026-09-02: origin/main-based section 4 could install a stale controller lacking Tranche B while record-manifest certifies the wrong installation; a manual command substitution would bypass the checked-in command-document contract.

outputs: tools/controller_update/update_controller_from_candidate.ps1 (single checked-in PS 5.1 operator script: -Phase install = pre-copy fail-closed identity verification + detached source worktree at the pinned SHA + robocopy /MIR + complete source-to-destination SHA-256 comparison + controller_update_evidence.json; -Phase verify-manifest = recorded-manifest cross-check against the accepted SOURCE digests, catching a manifest recorded from a wrong or tampered installation)

acceptance_scenarios: AS-SB-1 (R608/R612): docs/CONTROLLER_UPDATE_RUNBOOK.md section 4 presents exactly ONE concrete owner command invoking the checked-in tools/controller_update/update_controller_from_candidate.ps1; the fenced block contains the literal 40-hex SHA 1489879e1f6787a9d53ed74db4524b24039e03a2, no angle-bracket placeholder, and no git ref resolution; `grep -n origin/main docs/CONTROLLER_UPDATE_RUNBOOK.md` returns no match; `python tools/supervisor_command_doc_check.py` (default docs) exits 0.

AS-SB-2 (R609/R613a-d): on a deterministic fixture git repo, -Phase install exits 0 only when repo identity, normalized origin, full-SHA commit existence, commit tree, tools/agent_supervisor subtree tree, required modules (incl. mrl_launch_draft.py), and a clean DETACHED source worktree at the exact commit all verify; the binding value 'origin/main' is refused as not_a_full_sha; a self-consistent wrong commit is refused (tree_mismatch/subtree_mismatch); a commit missing mrl_launch_draft.py is refused (missing_module) - each with a typed reason and raw nonzero exit.

AS-SB-3 (R610/R613e): after a successful install, every installed file's raw SHA-256 equals the accepted source worktree file's digest bidirectionally (no missing, no unexpected, no changed file), recorded in controller_update_evidence.json; mutating one destination byte afterwards makes -Phase verify-manifest refuse with content_mismatch.

AS-SB-4 (R611/R613f): -Phase verify-manifest refuses a controller manifest whose key set or LF-normalized digests disagree with the accepted SOURCE tree (manifest_key_set_mismatch/manifest_digest_mismatch), and accepts a manifest whose digests match digests computed independently (python hashlib) from the source; the update evidence binds source commit SHA, tree, subtree tree, and per-file digests.

AS-SB-5 (R589/R613 mutations): targeted mutants disabling the tree check, the module check, the content comparison, and the manifest cross-check are each KILLED by the corresponding rejection fixture (mutant passes where the real script refuses => detected); the mutant generator fails closed if a mutation pattern no longer matches exactly once.

AS-SB-6 (R612/R618): every fenced powershell block in docs/CONTROLLER_UPDATE_RUNBOOK.md and the operator script parse under real PowerShell 5.1 with zero parser errors; tools/controller_update/ps_tests/run_ps_tests.ps1 exits 0 with raw exit codes preserved; modularity --check and the governance validators PASS; ruff scope introduces no new finding.
risks: PS 5.1 parser/quoting quirks (no && chains, backtick continuation) - mitigated by the parse test and running every test in a real powershell.exe -File process

command-document tooth invocation-marker trap: a fenced runbook line containing agent_supervisor/mrl_launch_draft.py would be validated as a presented supervisor command - mitigated by keeping module paths inside source_binding.json and the script, never in fenced runbook blocks

a fully re-computed tampered binding contract cannot be distinguished by the script alone - bounded by the checked-in reviewed contract, the git history, and the runbook instruction to compare the printed identity against the acceptance record (disclosed in the producer report)
